subject: The follow-up sequence booking appointments while you sleep
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most fitness studios lose 60-70% of their leads not because the lead wasn't interested — but because no one followed up fast enough. The average studio takes over 24 hours to respond to a new inquiry. By then, they've already booked somewhere else.


Here's the fix: a 3-step AI follow-up sequence that runs the moment someone fills out your form or clicks your ad. Step one fires within 90 seconds — a personalized text that references their goal (weight loss, strength, whatever they opted in for). Step two goes out 3 hours later if no reply — a simple check-in with your booking link. Step three goes out the next morning. Studios running this sequence are booking 2-3x more consultations from the same ad spend — not because they're spending more, but because they're not letting leads go cold.
